islet transplantation has evolved to a standard of care for patients with type 2 diabetes and that islet transplantation is a safe and efficacious procedure for patients with type 1 diabetes.

islet transplantation is a safe procedure that can be performed with a low risk of complications and with a high success rate.

the improvement of the clinical outcome of islet transplantation, with the aim of making the procedure available to a broader group of patients.

clinical islet transplantation is a safe procedure that has the potential of improving quality of life for a highly selective patient population.
islet cell transplantation has become the standard of care for selected patients, but is not ready for prime time.
islet transplantation is a safe and effective procedure that has been proven to improve the quality of life for a highly select group of patients.

islet transplantation has been proven safe, effective, and durable in the hands of experienced centers.
